skills.name: Electron configuration
skills.description: Writing the ground-state electron configuration of an atom or ion using the aufbau principle.
question_forms: write the ground-state electron configuration of an atom or ion
determine the number of valence electrons from an electron configuration

skills.name: Periodic trends
skills.description: Predicting relative atomic radius, ionization energy, and electronegativity from position on the periodic table.
question_forms: rank a set of elements by atomic radius, ionization energy, or electronegativity
explain a periodic trend using effective nuclear charge

skills.name: Lewis structures
skills.description: Drawing a valid Lewis structure, including formal charge and resonance where applicable.
question_forms: draw the Lewis structure of a molecule or ion
assign formal charges or identify resonance structures

skills.name: Molecular geometry
skills.description: Applying VSEPR theory to predict molecular shape from a Lewis structure.
question_forms: predict the molecular geometry of a molecule from its Lewis structure
determine the bond angle given a molecule's electron-domain geometry

skills.name: Molecular polarity
skills.description: Determining whether a molecule is polar from its bond dipoles (via electronegativity differences) and its overall geometry.
question_forms: determine whether a molecule is polar or nonpolar
explain why a molecule with polar bonds is nonpolar overall

skills.name: Mole conversions
skills.description: Converting between mass, moles, and number of particles using molar mass and Avogadro's number.
question_forms: convert between mass, moles, and number of particles
compute the molar mass of a compound

skills.name: Balancing equations
skills.description: Balancing a chemical equation so atom counts match on both sides.
question_forms: balance a given chemical equation
determine the correct coefficients for a reaction

skills.name: Limiting reagent
skills.description: Identifying the limiting reagent in a reaction and computing theoretical yield from it.
question_forms: identify the limiting reagent given starting amounts of reactants
calculate the theoretical yield of a product

skills.name: Ideal gas law
skills.description: Applying PV = nRT to relate pressure, volume, temperature, and moles of a gas, including finding moles of a gas produced by a balanced reaction.
question_forms: solve for an unknown gas variable using PV = nRT
find the moles or volume of a gas produced by a reaction

skills.name: Enthalpy of reaction
skills.description: Computing the enthalpy change of a reaction from bond energies or formation enthalpies.
question_forms: calculate the enthalpy change of a reaction from bond energies
calculate the enthalpy change of a reaction from formation enthalpies

skills.name: Hess's law
skills.description: Combining known reaction enthalpies to find the enthalpy of a target reaction.
question_forms: use Hess's law to find the enthalpy of a target reaction from given reactions
manipulate and combine given reaction enthalpies

skills.name: Reaction quotient
skills.description: Writing the equilibrium expression and using Q versus K to predict reaction direction.
question_forms: write the equilibrium expression for a reaction
compare Q to K to predict which direction a reaction will proceed

skills.name: Le Chatelier's principle
skills.description: Predicting how a stressed equilibrium shifts in response to a change in concentration, temperature, or (for gaseous equilibria) volume and pressure.
question_forms: predict how a stressed equilibrium shifts in response to a change
explain the effect of adding or removing a reactant or product at equilibrium

skills.name: pH calculations
skills.description: Computing pH or pOH from concentration, including for weak acids and bases at equilibrium.
question_forms: calculate the pH of a strong or weak acid or base solution
find the concentration of a species at equilibrium given Ka or Kb
